id.description: The entry id with ':' turned into '-', then -2, -3… when that is taken.

entry.description: The library entry that was added: <kind>:<slug>.

version.description: The entry's version when it was added.

shelf.description: The shelf it came from: the entry's `source`, which equals its shelf's name (framework, dao…).

created.description: Every record the add created, with its hash as created: how a removal tells a record edited since the add.

by.description: Sealed: the member who applied or proposed the add. Null only while staged.

at.description: Sealed: the day it was applied or proposed (the decision row dates a ratify). Null only while staged.

removed.description: Null while installed. On removal, { by, at, decision }, sealed the same way.

base.description: SHA-256 of the record's canonical YAML as created. Null only while staged.

rule.description: The Org-Rule value of the commit.

proposal.description: The proposal that ratified it; its decision row is found by its `proposal` field.

decision.description: Sealed: a change applied directly, or a proposal ratified. Null only while staged.

$comment: data/library.yaml (DAO-OS L1, ruling L1-R1): the library's receipts. Written only through the library's Add and Remove; lib/receipts.mjs checkReceipts reports a committed receipt with a null seal. `modified` (an array of the same recordBase) is reserved for L7's entries that change existing records.
